rows.statement: AASM Scoring Manual version 3 was released on 15 February 2023.

source.title: Polysomnography for OSA should include arousal-based scoring: AASM position statement

rows.statement: AASM recommended adult hypopnoea scoring is airflow reduction ≥30% for ≥10 seconds with ≥3% oxygen desaturation or arousal; version 3 changed the ≥4% rule from acceptable to optional.

source.title: AASM releases updated version of scoring manual
source.locator: AASM position statement on recommended hypopnoea criteria; AASM v3 updates announcement

rows.notes: “≥30% ... ≥10 seconds ... either an arousal or ≥3% oxygen desaturation”

rows.statement: In OSA, the proposed Epworth Sleepiness Scale MID is 2 points.

source.title: Minimum important difference of the Epworth Sleepiness Scale in obstructive sleep apnoea

rows.notes: “We propose an MID for the ESS of 2 points”

rows.statement: EU driving directive classifies moderate OSA syndrome as AHI 15–29 and severe as AHI ≥30, both associated with excessive daytime sleepiness.

source.title: Commission Directive 2014/85/EU amending Directive 2006/126/EC on driving licences

rows.notes: “between 15 and 29 ... 30 or more, both associated with excessive daytime sleepiness”

rows.statement: CNAS CPAP/BPAP renewal adherence rule is ≥4 hours per night on ≥70% of nights during the last 3 months.
rows.notes: “≥4 ore pe noapte ... ≥70% din nopți în ultimele 3 luni”
